title: KW T909 Fups Compliant Custom Built polished Aluminium Road Train Bullbar #90
description: Kenworth T900, T908,T909,T950 Fups compliant polished Road Train hi-tensile 5 post aluminium bull bar. Extended main channel cowcatcher and 4 small upright. 88mm pipe and a full width cross pipe above headlights. All cross pipes are one piece and pass through the drilled uprights, no butt welds. The heavy duty box uprights are 6mm wall high tensile aluminium for maximum strength and protection. Reversible aluminium Road Train signs. Heavy duty high tensile aluminium backing plate with 38mm tow pin with polished aluminium tow plate. Main bumper channel with the KW Logo engraved in the return panel to which is contoured to match the mudguard.The top bar is a custom made extrusion to mount driving lights . Optional 76mm or100mm diameter tube is available on request.
